design.null: entry months for a unit are drawn with probability proportional to the unit's at-risk count in that month, preserving the number of entries and conditioning out lane growth and risk-set size
design.require_prior_filer_note: when set, an entry only counts if the entity was already an observable filer (some event in another track before the entry month); this separates firm-level technology entry from a brand-new legal entity appearing in the lane
design.statistic: variance/mean of monthly entry counts (dispersion index)
design.unit: technology-entry event (company, track, first observed month)
